pairs.why: The two capsules look almost the same in shape, metal finish, glow and background, so neither is meaningfully closer to the soft, saturated real cards.
This pair looks the same as q136, and I can't see a difference in rendering, shape or finish that would pick one.
The masts match, but B's red beacon has a soft glow halo, like the glowing lamps and neon on the real cards, while A's reads as a flat plastic bead.
The objects match, and B's slightly warmer, glowing beacon and softer light sit a little closer to the warm, lit-from-within feel of the real cards.
The masts match, but A's raised roof edge and cast shadow give a staged, grounded scene like the real cards, while B's flat, empty ground plane looks plainer.
The objects match, and B's roof-edge setting, longer cast shadow and glowing beacon are closer to the real cards than A's flat, empty horizon.
Both masts and both rooftop scenes are almost the same, and both share the same greyish concrete that is duller than the real cards.
The masts match, and B's beacon glows a little, echoing the lit elements on the real cards, but the difference is tiny.
